title: Power Platform: maker guidelines shown inside the Copilot Studio Review pane
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented settings, licensing caveats and control paths are supported. One minor qualification is missing: the custom guidance documentation describes agents and agent flows powered by the standard harness.

claims.where: What's changing; summary; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Maker guidelines lets Power Platform administrators share organizational guidance and help links with Copilot Studio makers while they build.
claims.quote: Maker guidelines let Power Platform administrators share organization-specific guidance with Copilot Studio makers while they build. Use the message to explain what is available in an environment and direct makers to internal guidance, request processes, or support.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The message appears in Copilot Studio's Review pane alongside the agent's blockers and warnings.
claims.quote: When a maker selects Review for an agent in Copilot Studio, the pane shows the agent's blockers and warnings together with A message from your admin.

claims.claim: The heading shown to makers is A message from your admin.
claims.quote: When a maker selects Review for an agent in Copilot Studio, the pane shows the agent's blockers and warnings together with A message from your admin.

claims.claim: Maker guidelines remain available when the agent has no issues.
claims.quote: Maker guidelines remain available when the agent has no blockers or warnings, giving makers a consistent place to find organizational expectations and help.

claims.claim: Maker guidelines requires Managed Environments.
claims.quote: Maker guidelines is available only for managed environments.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Administrators configure maker guidelines for an individual managed environment or an environment group.
claims.quote: You can configure maker guidelines for an individual managed environment or for an environment group.

claims.quote:

claims.claim: The maker guidelines message is plain text.
claims.quote: Enter a plain-text message of up to 400 characters.

claims.claim: Administrators can optionally provide an HTTPS Button link.

claims.quote: A Button label of up to 50 characters.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Administrators can optionally provide a contact email that makers can use for help.
claims.quote:
A Contact email that makers can use for help.
The maker can use the configured link or email without leaving the Review experience.

claims.claim: Published environment-group rules override environment-level maker guidelines messages.
claims.quote: When a rule is published at the environment group level, it's enforced across every environment within that group. This means the corresponding setting or policy becomes locked (read-only) within individual environments

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout; controls[2].note
claims.claim: The related custom guidance message preview replaces Contact your admin when a maker encounters blocked connectors or channels.
claims.quote:
This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness.
As an admin, you can set an environment-level guidance message for users when they encounter a blocked or disabled capability. This plain-text message replaces the default Contact your admin prompt.
claims.fix: Replace the first custom-guidance sentence with: 'For agents and agent flows powered by the standard harness, a related preview, custom guidance message, replaces the generic "Contact your admin" prompt that appears when a maker hits a blocked connector or channel.'

claims.claim: The related Maker guidance panel uses field labels different from those on the maker guidelines page.
claims.quote:
In the Your message field, set the custom guidance message.
In the URL name and URL link fields, set the display name for the custom URL and the link URL respectively.

claims.claim: The custom guidance panel offers an option to display guidance from Agent status.
claims.quote: Under Agent status, select either or both of the Display guidance messaging when makers select View on Agent status and Display guidance messaging in popovers for blocked items check boxes.

claims.claim: Custom guidance messages are not localized.
claims.quote: Custom guidance messages aren't localized. The message appears exactly as configured, regardless of users' language settings.

claims.claim: Custom guidance links remain functional as links even when their destination is unreachable.
claims.quote: Link functionality remains available even if the destination URL is unreachable. Maintain valid links for the best experience.

claims.claim: Editing group-governed settings requires appropriate edit rights at the environment-group level.
claims.quote: Any subsequent changes can only be made by a tenant administrator with appropriate edit rights at the environment group level.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents creating environment groups and configuring their rules for Power Platform tenant administrators.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Power Platform Admin center as a Power Platform tenant administrator.
After you create the environment group, Power Platform tenant administrators can immediately add managed environments or configure the group's rules.

claims.claim: Maker welcome content is a separate experience that sets expectations when makers first enter the product.

claims.claim: The environment setting is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Maker guidelines > Environments > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: Environment: Select Copilot > Settings, and then select Maker guidelines. Select the Environments tab, select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.claim: The group rule is at Manage > Environment groups > group > Rules > Add rules > Maker guidelines > Save > Publish rules, with Add rules conditional on the rule not already being listed.
claims.quote:
Select Manage > Environment groups, select the environment group, and then select the Rules tab. If Maker guidelines isn't listed, select Add rules, find Maker guidelines, and add it to the group.
On the environment group's Rules tab, select Save, and then select Publish rules.

On the sidebar, select Copilot, and then select Settings.
